Десять атомарных карточек без пересечения файлов; index.ts и types.ts не трогаем, сведение экспортов и Game.ts — следующая волна.","tasks":[{"key":"t1","title":"RotatingBar/Windmill/Spinner/Pendulum kinematics","description":"TASK: implement pure rotating-obstacle motion helpers.
GOAL: deterministic angle and deflection for rotating hazards, unit tested.
FILE: create src/obstacles/rotating.ts and src/obstacles/rotating.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: helpers to reuse:
- src/contracts/math.ts: export interface Vec3 { x:number; y:number; z:number }
- src/obstacles/vec.ts exports: vec3, cloneVec3, addVec3, subVec3, scaleVec3, dotVec3, lengthVec3, distanceVec3, normalizeVec3(v):Vec3|null, rotateAroundY(v,radians):Vec3 (right handed, Three.js convention).
Define locally in rotating.ts:
export type RotatingKind='bar'|'windmill'|'spinner'|'pendulum';
export interface RotatingConfig{id:string;kind:RotatingKind;center:Vec3;armLength:number;speed:number;phase?:number;clockwise?:boolean;swingAngle?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export function rotationAngle(c:RotatingConfig,elapsed:number):number
export function armTipPosition(c:RotatingConfig,elapsed:number):Vec3
export function surfaceVelocityAt(c:RotatingConfig,point:Vec3,elapsed:number):Vec3
export function deflectBall(c:RotatingConfig,position:Vec3,velocity:Vec3,elapsed:number,hitRadius:number):Vec3|null
Rules: angle = (phase??0) + speed*elapsed for bar/windmill/spinner, sign flipped when clockwise===true; pendulum uses angle = (phase??0) + (swingAngle??Math.PI/3)*Math.sin(speed*elapsed). armTipPosition = center + rotateAroundY({x:armLength,y:0,z:0}, angle). surfaceVelocityAt returns the tangential velocity around Y: omega = d(angle)/dt, r = point-center, result {x: omega*r.z, y:0, z:-omega*r.x}. deflectBall returns null when the horizontal distance from the arm segment center..tip exceeds hitRadius, otherwise the reflected velocity about the arm normal plus the surfaceVelocityAt contribution. Guard non finite input and speed 0.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM, no imports from src/obstacles/index.ts or src/obstacles/types.ts; do not edit any existing file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests covering angle progression, clockwise sign, pendulum angle bounds, tip position, null outside hitRadius, speed added on hit. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/rotating.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 1"},{"key":"t2","title":"MovingPlatform, SlidingWall and Door movers","description":"TASK: implement pure kinematic mover helpers.
GOAL: time based position and carry velocity for moving platforms, sliding walls and doors.
FILE: create src/obstacles/movers.ts and src/obstacles/movers.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: reuse src/obstacles/vec.ts: addVec3, subVec3, scaleVec3, normalizeVec3(v):Vec3|null, cloneVec3, lengthVec3. Vec3 type from '../contracts/math'.
Define locally in movers.ts:
export type MoverKind='platform'|'sliding-wall'|'door';
export type MoverLoop='ping-pong'|'loop'|'once';
export interface MoverConfig{id:string;kind:MoverKind;origin:Vec3;axis:Vec3;distance:number;speed:number;phase?:number;loop?:MoverLoop;pauseSeconds?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export interface MoverSample{position:Vec3;velocity:Vec3;progress:number}
export function sampleMover(c:MoverConfig,elapsed:number):MoverSample
export function carryVelocity(c:MoverConfig,elapsed:number,contact:boolean):Vec3
Rules: travel time = distance/speed; speed<=0 or distance<=0 gives a static sample at origin with zero velocity and progress 0. The cycle includes pauseSeconds (default 0) at each end. progress is 0..1 along the normalized axis; ping-pong goes 0->1->0, loop wraps 0->1, once clamps at 1. position = origin + normalizedAxis*distance*progress. velocity is the derivative and is zero during a pause. phase (seconds, default 0) offsets elapsed. Non finite or zero axis is treated as static. carryVelocity returns the sample velocity when contact is true, otherwise a zero vector.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/obstacles/index.ts, src/obstacles/types.ts or any other existing file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: ping-pong reverses direction, loop wraps, once clamps and ends with zero velocity, pause freezes velocity, phase offsets position. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/movers.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 2"},{"key":"t3","title":"Bumper, SpringPad, BoostPad and JumpPad","description":"TASK: implement impulse pad obstacles.
GOAL: four pad kinds that turn a ball sample into a velocity change, unit tested.
FILE: create src/obstacles/pads.ts and src/obstacles/pads.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: import these existing modules instead of copying them:
- src/obstacles/zones.ts: type ZoneShape = BoxZone|SphereZone|CylinderZone, zoneContains(zone,point,margin?), zoneFalloff(zone,point).
- src/obstacles/vec.ts: scaleVec3, addVec3, subVec3, normalizeVec3, lengthVec3, dotVec3.

Define locally in pads.ts:
export type PadKind='bumper'|'spring'|'boost'|'jump';
export interface PadConfig{id:string;kind:PadKind;zone:ZoneShape;strength:number;direction?:Vec3;maxSpeed?:number;cooldownSeconds?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export interface PadHit{padId:string;kind:PadKind;velocity:Vec3}
export class PadObstacle{constructor(config:PadConfig); readonly id:string; readonly kind:PadKind; enabled:boolean; update(position:Vec3,velocity:Vec3,elapsed:number):PadHit|null; reset():void}
Behaviour: bumper reflects the incoming horizontal velocity away from the zone center and scales it by strength with a minimum bounce speed of strength*0.5; spring adds strength along direction (default {x:0,y:1,z:0}) and keeps horizontal velocity; boost adds strength along the normalized direction scaled by zoneFalloff; jump sets vertical velocity to strength and keeps horizontal. Every result is clamped by cappedVelocity with maxSpeed (default 24). cooldownSeconds (default 0.25) blocks retriggering by storing the last trigger time; reset() clears it. Return null when disabled, outside the zone, or still in cooldown.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/obstacles/index.ts or src/obstacles/types.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 6 tests, one per kind plus cooldown blocking and max speed clamping. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/pads.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.

GOAL: one function set mapping a SurfaceMaterial to physics parameters plus per step rolling damping.
FILE: create src/obstacles/surfaces.ts and src/obstacles/surfaces.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: types to import:
- src/courses/types.ts: export type SurfaceMaterial = 'green'|'rough'|'sand'|'ice'|'wood'|'stone'|'metal'; export interface SurfaceDescriptor { id:string; transform:TransformDescriptor; shape:'box'|'ramp'|'cylinder'|'mesh'; size:Vec3; material:SurfaceMaterial; friction?:number; restitution?:number }
- src/physics/helpers.ts: clamp(value,min,max), magnitude(v).
Define locally in surfaces.ts:
export interface SurfaceProperties{friction:number;restitution:number;rollingResistance:number;slipFactor:number}
export const SURFACE_PROPERTIES:Record<SurfaceMaterial,SurfaceProperties>
export function resolveSurface(descriptor:Pick<SurfaceDescriptor,'material'|'friction'|'restitution'>):SurfaceProperties
export function applySurfaceDamping(velocity:Vec3,surface:SurfaceProperties,dt:number):Vec3
export function stopsOnSurface(speed:number,surface:SurfaceProperties,stopThreshold:number):boolean
Table, in order friction / restitution / rollingResistance / slipFactor: green 0.55 / 0.32 / 0.35 / 0.35; rough 0.9 / 0.12 / 0.9 / 0.3; sand 1.1 / 0.08 / 1.2 / 0.25; ice 0.04 / 0.4 / 0.02 / 0.95; wood 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.3 / 0.5; stone 0.6 / 0.4 / 0.35 / 0.45; metal 0.35 / 0.6 / 0.22 / 0.7. resolveSurface lets descriptor.friction and descriptor.restitution override the table, clamped to 0..2 and 0..1. applySurfaceDamping returns a NEW Vec3 with x and z multiplied by max(0, 1 - rollingResistance*dt) and y untouched. stopsOnSurface returns speed <= stopThreshold*(1+rollingResistance).
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/courses/*, src/physics/* or src/obstacles/index.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: ice keeps far more speed than sand after 1 second of damping, overrides win over the table, damping never yields negative speed, stop threshold behaviour, every SurfaceMaterial key present in SURFACE_PROPERTIES. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/surfaces.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.

export interface MatchRewardInput{rank:number;playerCount:number;holesPlayed:number;holesCompleted:number;totalStrokes:number;coursePar:number;holesInOne:number;birdies:number;durationSeconds:number}

XP rules: completion 100; win (rank===1) +50; podium (rank 2 or 3 and playerCount>=4) +25; +20 per hole in one; +10 per birdie. Win and podium are mutually exclusive. xp is the sum, floored at 0 and rounded to an integer.
applyMatchStatistics returns a NEW object: increments matchesPlayed, increments matchesWon when rank===1, adds holesPlayed, holesCompleted, totalStrokes and holesInOne, adds Math.max(0,Math.round(durationSeconds)) to totalPlayTimeSeconds, and sets bestRoundStrokes to the smaller of the old value and totalStrokes only when holesCompleted === holesPlayed and holesPlayed > 0. Treat non finite numbers as 0. Never mutate the input stats.
CONSTRAINTS: no DOM, no Three.js, no Rapier; do not edit src/gameplay/index.ts or any existing gameplay file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 6 tests: winner baseline xp is 150, podium only applies with 4+ players, hole in one and birdie bonuses, input stats not mutated, bestRoundStrokes set only on a full round, bestRoundStrokes keeps the lower value. Run `npx vitest run src/gameplay/rewards.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.

export type BotTurnPhase='idle'|'thinking'|'aiming'|'shooting'|'done';
export interface BotTurnTiming{thinkSeconds:number;aimSeconds:number;shootSeconds:number}
export interface BotTurnStatus{phase:BotTurnPhase;statusText:string;showAimLine:boolean;fireShot:boolean;progress:number}
export class BotTurnScheduler{constructor(timing?:Partial<BotTurnTiming>,random?:RandomSource); begin(botName:string,personality?:string):void; update(dt:number):BotTurnStatus; get phase():BotTurnPhase; reset():void}
export function timingForProfile(personality:string,planningDepth:number,random?:RandomSource):BotTurnTiming
Defaults: thinkSeconds 0.9, aimSeconds 0.8, shootSeconds 0.35. timingForProfile scales think time by planningDepth (+0.25s per depth above 1) and by personality ('careful' x1.25, 'bold' x0.8, 'trickster' x1.1, otherwise x1), then adds random()*0.3 jitter when a RandomSource is given.
update(dt) advances an internal clock and returns the current status: thinking uses statusText `${botName} is thinking` with showAimLine false; aiming uses `${botName} is aiming` with showAimLine true; shooting sets fireShot true on the FIRST update entering that phase only, after which the phase becomes done with empty statusText. progress is 0..1 inside the current phase. begin() restarts the clock; reset() returns to idle.
CONSTRAINTS: no DOM, no setTimeout, no Date.now, no Three.js; do not edit src/ai/index.ts or any existing ai file.
